findings.text: non-blocking: the stdout check was weakened from the exact `2s` bound to a generic `\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?s\b` regex, so a regression that prints an unrelated or hardcoded duration (for example the module default 30s instead of the patched 12s) would still pass, and the claim that the message names the bound that ended the attempt is no longer verified.

item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are tests/test_arm_lock_is_never_held_by_a_follower.py plus the landing fragment and figure directories; the two-commit diff touches exactly the test file and docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/the-arming-test-gives-its-stop-room.html.

justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_arm_lock_is_never_held_by_a_follower.py:65 sizes the bound for the measured 1.75-4.01 s interpreter start and :230 keeps the delivery assertion, so both claims survive the change.
